newsitem.title: USA: National Bank of Greece loan officer pleads guilty.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Greece loan officer pleads guilty.

text.p: A former loan officer for the National Bank of Greece pleaded guilty on Thursday to federal charges of fraud, the U.S. Attorney for Massachusetts said.

Alice Andrews, 41, of Lowell, Mass., pleaded guilty to charges she used her position as a loan officer and administrator of the Boston banch of the bank to embezzle about $95,000 in funds from the accounts of two customers living in Canada.
Andrews faces up to 25 years in prison and fines totalling $1.25 million when she is sentneced on December 18.

Andrews is the second of three defendants to plead guilty to charges of fraud and embezzlement at the bank. Former National Bank of Greece branch manager Lakis Theoharis pleaded guilty on September 18, to similar charges.
The third defendant, Peter Bekeas, who served as a credit officer at the branch is scheduled for trial on the charges.
